title: Libre 2 plus / 2+  C6 sensor not recognised. Patchinfo 0xC60931
body:
> I have created oop2 version for the c6 libre2. Please note that we are using the first 3 numbers so I might need more information for this. Right now it is 0xc60930
> 
> oop2: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1z4IzWla5nor2JJbXVglWhhWXUG_nMmok/view?usp=sharing
> 
> The xdrip version is: https://drive.google.com/file/d/14NOgsjTTt0jN2TJ5yWICUZtiJc9254w4/view?usp=sharing

I was unsuccesful with a UK Libre 2plus sensor and these files. patchinfo reports as C6 09 31 @tzachi-dar   Libre 2plus is rolling out as the default L2 sensor in the UK.

_Originally posted by @PhilTU in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3439#discussioncomment-9561211_
